name: hearth_crackle
prompt: A wood fire burning steadily in a stone fireplace in a quiet room, close: soft continuous crackling and gentle popping of dry logs, a low warm flutter of flames, occasional small snaps, an even level throughout. Only the fire, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: hearth_embers
prompt: A fireplace burned down to glowing embers: very quiet, sparse soft ticks and tiny crackles of cooling coals over a faint low hiss, long gaps between them. Only the embers, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: log_settle
prompt: Burning logs in a fireplace shifting and settling once: a soft hollow wooden knock as a charred log slumps onto the iron grate, a brief shower of crackling embers, then quiet. Single event, no music, no voices, dry.

name: tallwindow_rain
prompt: Rain pattering on a tall old window pane heard from inside a quiet room, close to the glass: soft irregular drops tapping on glass and thin rivulets, steady, no thunder, no wind. Only the rain on the glass, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: page_turn
prompt: A single page of an old hardback book turned slowly by hand, close-up: a crisp soft paper rustle as the page lifts, a gentle flutter, the page settling flat and a fingertip smoothing it. One page turn, no music, no voices, dry.

name: pen_scratch
prompt: A fountain pen writing slowly on thick paper on a wooden desk, close-up: fine scratchy nib strokes forming a few words with tiny pauses between them, a soft dot and a crossing stroke. Only the pen on paper, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: clock_tick
prompt: A tall antique grandfather clock ticking in a quiet room, exactly one tick per second, a deep wooden tick-tock of the pendulum escapement, steady and perfectly regular, close. Only the clock ticking, no chimes, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: clock_strike
prompt: An old grandfather clock striking once: a single deep soft strike on a coiled gong rod, low and warm, with a long slowly fading hum, heard across a quiet room. Only one strike, no melody, no chime tune, no ticking, no music, no voices, dry.

name: floor_creak
prompt: A single slow creak of old wooden floorboards settling by themselves in a quiet old house at night, soft and low, no footsteps. Single sound, no music, no voices, dry.

name: shelf_creak
prompt: A tall old wooden bookcase creaking softly once as its wood settles at night, a dry low wooden groan and a faint tick. Single sound, no music, no voices, dry.

name: radiator_tick
prompt: An old cast iron radiator warming up in a quiet room at night: a few soft metallic ticks and pings and one faint knock in the pipes, sparse. Only the radiator, no music, no voices, dry, single source.

name: door_far
prompt: A heavy wooden door closing softly far away at the end of a long stone corridor in an old building at night, a muffled distant thud with a faint latch click and a little hallway echo. Single sound, no music, no voices, dry.

name: room_tone
prompt: Room tone of a large quiet old library reading room at night: a very soft steady hush of still air, faint and even, no hum, no clock, no rain. Only the room tone, no music, no voices, dry.
